name: close-grip-ez-bar-curl.html
instructions:
1. Grasp an EZ Bar with an underhand grip (palms facing up). Your hands should be about 6-8 inches apart.
2. Stand straight up, with your feet firmly on the floor at around shoulder width apart. You may find it more comfortable to take one foot back.
3. Keeping your body completely still and eyes facing forward, slowly curl the bar up as far as possible.
4. Squeeze your biceps at the top of the movement, and then slowly lower the weight back down.
5. Repeat for desired reps.
